title: JUKEBOX
tagline: A Web3 enabled streaming service that utilizes microtransactions for payments.
description: Rather than the usual business model of streaming services of paying monthly for content, Web3 and blockchain technology allows micropayments due to cheap transaction fees and allows users to only pay for what they consume. Content creators and entertainment companies also benefit by distributing the revenue seamlessly to the copyright holders, royalties, publishing and distribution agreements, and settle disputes all on chain. For marketing, we also enable fans and artists to create NFT communities and offer rewards to NFT holders for IRL merchandise, on chain rewards, services, and anything else they can think of. Fans can also get rewarded for bringing more fans into an artists NFT fan club.
how_its_made: This project is made using Next.js & React on the frontend. We also utilized ether.js and Cartesi to interact with smart contracts. We used firebase and IPFS as our back end solutions to handle media content (.mp4, .wmv, .mp3, etc...) and NFT's. The sponsors we used were Polygon, Unlock, IPFS, Livepeer, Gnosis, & Cartesi.
